name: svg-new
title: SVG.new
description: Convert images to SVG vectors and remove backgrounds with SVG.new.
author: svgnew

commands.name: convert-to-svg
commands.title: Convert Image to SVG
commands.subtitle: SVG.new
commands.description: Convert the image selected in Finder to an SVG saved next to it.

commands.name: convert-clipboard-to-svg
commands.title: Convert Clipboard Image to SVG
commands.subtitle: SVG.new
commands.description: Convert the image on the clipboard to an SVG, save it to Downloads and copy it.

commands.name: remove-background
commands.title: Remove Background
commands.subtitle: SVG.new
commands.description: Remove the background from the image selected in Finder and save a transparent PNG and SVG next to it.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your SVG.new API key from svg.new/account

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
